supporting_observations.claim: At 14:16:09 UTC, Explorer wrote a UserAssist registry value for ivy.chen whose ROT13-decoded name and path identify Windows PowerShell (powershell.exe). This is consistent with PowerShell having been launched, but the record does not establish when it was launched.

At about 13:40 UTC, proxy records show ivy.chen's workstation accessing the Salesforce login page and its associated web resources through Chrome; these records do not identify PowerShell as the source of that activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied sensor status reports that winsec and Sysmon collection for WS-ICHEN-01 was unavailable from 13:30 through 14:10 UTC due to a log collection outage; the status metadata contains no record_id.
Proxy, Zeek connection, and Zeek DNS sensors are reported as available, but they do not provide the missing endpoint process details for the reported time.
claims_not_established: Whether PowerShell was launched at or around the reported 13:40 UTC time.
The command line, parent process, execution context, or purpose of any PowerShell execution.
Whether the PowerShell activity represented by the 14:16 UserAssist record is related to the reported brief window or was malicious.
Whether any endpoint activity during the collection outage was benign or malicious.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain alternate endpoint telemetry for WS-ICHEN-01 from 13:30–14:10 UTC, including process creation, PowerShell operational logs, script block logs, and console or transcript records.
Review EDR or forensic artifacts that could establish PowerShell execution time, command line, parent process, and user context.
Confirm with ivy.chen whether PowerShell appeared around 13:40 UTC and what task, if any, was being performed.
unrelated_findings: At 13:26 UTC, WS-ICHEN-01 made a proxy tunnel to desktop.dropbox.com with a DropboxUpdate user agent. Dropbox is not listed as approved; assess separately. Records: T054-00061, T054-00062.

At 14:18 UTC, a Cisco AnyConnect vpnagent.exe process started on WS-ICHEN-01. The inventory says there is no VPN; the process record alone does not establish that a VPN connection occurred. Assess separately. Records: T054-00372, T054-00373.
